name: scribe
description: Professional documentation structure, product lifecycle, writing, and technical visual skills with one guided entry point.

interface.shortDescription: Structure and write clear professional documents.
interface.longDescription: Assess domain and product boundaries, plan general, domain, and product knowledge structures, evaluate product lifecycle readiness, then create focused knowledge, strategy, capability, solution, roadmap, PRD, metric, release, review, architecture, and visual artifacts through explicit composable skills.
defaultPrompt: Use $ask-scribe to explain which Scribe skills fit my task and how to combine them.
Use $structure-docs and $write-doc to plan a clear directory and file structure for this documentation set.
Use $reason-domain and $write-doc to decide whether this subject forms a reusable domain and record its boundary.
Use $structure-domain-docs, $reason-domain, $structure-docs, and $write-doc to create a coherent directory and reading path for this domain knowledge set.
Use $write-domain-doc, $reason-domain, and $write-doc to create the appropriate document for this accepted domain knowledge set.
Use $write-domain-doc, $reason-domain, and $write-doc to write a first-principles essence article for this accepted domain.
Use $reason-product and $write-doc to decide whether this subject is a product, product area, capability, solution, or another content class.
Use $assess-product-lifecycle, $reason-product, and $write-doc to identify the current product decision, evidence gaps, artifact coverage, and next actions.

Use $structure-product-docs, $reason-product, $assess-product-lifecycle, $structure-docs, $write-product-doc, and $write-doc to scaffold the seven-directory product knowledge core and both navigation maps.
Use $write-product-strategy, $reason-product, and $write-doc to define this product's direction, choices, non-goals, and review triggers.
Use $map-product-capabilities, $reason-product, and $write-doc to model this product's durable capabilities and responsibility boundaries.
Use $write-doc to draft a clear technical document from these notes.
Use $draw-diagrams and $write-doc to turn this architecture into a concise diagram.
